summary: Max Verstappen won the Hungarian Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 33.7s ahead of Lando Norris, with Sergio Perez completing the podium.
George Russell made the biggest climb, from P18 to P6.
Guanyu Zhou had a day to forget, dropping from P5 to P16.
The stewards penalised ZHO (5 second time penalty) and LEC (5 second time penalty).
There were 36 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 110 points over Sergio Perez.
